description: Prayer of Mending 390 Mana 40 yd range Instant 10 sec cooldown Requires Priest Requires level 60 Places a spell on the target that heals them for [(413 + (Healing * 0.42899999 )) * ( 1 * 1 )] the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yds. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.
name: Prayer of Mending
